summary: Phase S4 passes API, developer-experience, documentation, and UX-applicability review after remediation. The manifest now certifies the shipped graph, practice, SRS, and persistence contract labels; documented consumer and packed-consumer scripts exist; the evaluator, gate, proof, and release checker are public and documented; the pinned ra-math cutover is reproducible and read-only.
nonblocking_findings: The packed-consumer gate performs real local builds and pack inspection, so CI should retain the package-level 180 second timeout and monitor duration.
The ra-math cutover intentionally remains an external Measure task because its inspected checkout was dirty and belongs to a different repository.
evidence: Manifest and Codecamp proof suites pass 20/20 after aligning knowledge-space.v1, practice.v1, srs.contract.v2, and mastery.persistence.v1.
Packed artifact suite passes 2/2; package type-check and lint pass.
Package scripts expose check:consumer, test:codecamp-proof, and test:packed-consumer; README commands match them.
Code graph resolves runSyntheticCodecampProof and the new runtime tooling exports.
